label: Biden unable to continue, drops out of 2024 race
description: Sep 30 2023: Joe Biden not able to keep going because of mental problems. He dropped out Jul 21 2024.

label: Red wave starting from Michigan in 2024
description: Jul 14 2024: I saw a red wave coming out of Michigan. Trump won MI and swept all 7 swing states.

label: PA, NV, AZ are key swing states, very close races
description: Oct 24 2024: Pennsylvania is a key, Nevada and Arizona in jeopardy, very close races. All three went for Trump.

label: Elon Musk is not a true friend, will turn on Trump
description: Oct 30 2024: big devil behind him, he is not a true friend. Musk publicly turned on Trump May-Jun 2025.

label: Egg and chicken shortage from bird disease
description: Sep 2 2024: I saw live chickens, cages, racks of eggs. Bird flu killed 100M+ birds, egg prices doubled Feb 2025.

label: Gold will rise significantly
description: Dec 10 2023: the gold will rise. Gold went from $2050 to $3300+ (65% gain through 2025).

label: Revival breaks out on Senate floor
description: Nov 1 2024: I saw great Revival breaking out on the Senate floor. Has not happened.

label: US military draft reinstated
description: Sep 30 2023: I saw men and women being drafted. No draft has been instituted.
